_meta: Deterministic claim rules. Add a claim by adding an entry. type: nutrient_min | ingredient_absence | ambiguous | no_evidence. working_threshold_* values are configurable working values, NOT official unless the matching regulatory_references.json entry has verified=true.

high_protein.label: High protein
high_protein.description: Compares protein per 100 g with a configurable threshold.
can_infer_supported: The product contains a high protein amount according to the reference used.
can_infer_other: The product is marketed with a "High protein" claim.

no_added_sugar.label: No added sugar
no_added_sugar.description: Scans the ingredient list for added-sugar ingredient names.
can_infer_supported: No added-sugar ingredient names appear in the ingredient list available.
can_infer_other: The product is marketed with a "No added sugar" claim.
do_not_infer: Sugar-free (total sugars can still come from fruit, milk or other ingredients)

no_added_salt.label: No added salt
no_added_salt.description: Scans the ingredient list for salt ingredient names.
can_infer_supported: No added-salt ingredient names appear in the ingredient list available.
can_infer_other: The product is marketed with a "No added salt" claim.

high_fibre.label: High / rich in fibre
high_fibre.description: Compares dietary fibre per 100 g with a configurable threshold.
can_infer_supported: The product contains a high fibre amount according to the reference used.
can_infer_other: The product is marketed with a "High fibre" claim.

natural.label: Natural
natural.description: 'Natural' has no fixed test. ClaimGuard checks the ingredient list and processing indicators (additives, NOVA group) and never marks it SUPPORTED automatically.
natural.ambiguity_reason: The product presents a 'Natural' claim, but the available product evidence does not provide enough information to independently establish the complete meaning of the claim.
can_infer_other: The product is marketed using a "Natural" claim.
do_not_infer: The entire product is necessarily healthy

farm_fresh.label: Farm fresh
farm_fresh.description: Farm origin/freshness is not something Open Food Facts nutrition or ingredient data can establish.
farm_fresh.ambiguity_reason: Open Food Facts data does not record farm origin or freshness in a form ClaimGuard can check.
can_infer_other: The product is marketed using a "Farm fresh" claim.
do_not_infer: The product was made or grown on a farm
The product was recently produced or harvested
The product is unprocessed or preservative-free

healthy.label: Healthy
healthy.description: 'Healthy' cannot be settled by one number. ClaimGuard flags nutrients that are HIGH per 100 g (working reference: UK FSA front-of-pack 'red' levels, not an FSSAI value) and never marks it SUPPORTED automatically.
healthy.ambiguity_reason: 'Healthy' is a broad claim. Nutrient values alone cannot establish it, and no single verified test is available in the current knowledge base.
can_infer_other: The product is marketed using a "Healthy" claim.
do_not_infer: Low in sugar, fat and calories
